correctness.rationale: Exact occupation conditioning leaves paths of lengths n−3 and n−6; the derived polynomial covariance is checked against labelled exhaustive enumeration at n=7,9,11,13. For n=2m+1≥7 its first nonzero coefficient is positive at z^3 and its high-activity limit (n−m²)/n² is negative. Using the exact transfer-root ratio, R_n=z²(1+o(1)) uniformly at z=W(ne^s)/n and p_h/z²→e^(−s), proving the normalized profile and existence of zeros at n z−W(n)→0. Numerical checks are supplementary only.

value.rationale: Distance three is the first nonadjacent odd separation on the rim. Shared-hub vacancy mixing creates positive correlation at low activity, opposing the cycle hard-core negative correlation. The exact Lambert-W(n)/n window and the universal covariance profile quantify an intrinsic finite-size crossover on a canonical graph family and furnish a benchmark for join-graph correlation studies. This is not a cosmetic formula or a thermodynamic phase-transition claim.
